owner_calls.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
owner_calls.question: Dex kills the task force officers who torture Cherry and unmask Matt (S2#1), then kills the two officers who came to the hospital for Cherry (S2#2). He never speaks to Cherry, and it is unclear he acts for him rather than for Matt or himself. Add a stage?
options: None: Dex acts around Cherry, not with him
Add enemy stage at Daredevil: Born Again S2#1: Dex guns down the task force officers who attack Cherry, sparing him and Matt.
owner_calls.evidence: The Northern Star: AVTF officers attack Cherry, Murdock rescues him and is unmasked, and Dex kills the officers. Shoot the Moon: officers retreat from Cherry's guarded room and Bullseye kills them on their way out.
